beats.speech: Don't say I'm tired. Here are three better ways.
I'm beat: Leo walks home after work. I'm beat.
Running on empty: He skipped lunch. He's running on empty.

card.headline: Wiped out
card.use: He falls asleep on the sofa.

beats.speech: Wiped out: He falls asleep on the sofa. He's wiped out.
Which one will you use? Comment yours!
